decision: Existing detached legacy telemetry may copy scalar ResourceKindStats values and exact static built-in ResourceKind constants from scoped admitted selected stats. The legacy output owns independent values and retains no selected arrays/strings/token/proof/namespace/backing. Selected acquisition/union/scratch remains admitted and scoped. Do not replace physical union/dedup/max-frontier/high-water semantics with naive per-set sums. Preserve generic/nil/foreign custom kind behavior; unsupported custom selected names use existing refusal/unavailable behavior without alias/relabel. Prove actual production kinds are supported and outputs survive scoped Close with proportional real-caller/refusal characterization. No new disposal API, authority or universal old telemetry quota.
scope: Same existing all19 closure; necessary actual coordinator/command-WAL metrics callers, not new product or graph scope.
